text:
maria.partners: Heads up — starting integration work for CloudX marketplace billing. Need to align on: minute vs hourly usage granularity, webhook signature format, entitlement id mapping, and replay/backfill plan. Pinging infra + product to validate assumptions.

aj.ops: rough Qs — do they send per-minute pulses or hourly aggregates? and do we expect timezone offsets in the payload? :thinking_face:

maria.partners: CloudX can do both; they prefer minute pulses for edge devices but also offer hourly rollups as fallback. They said timestamps are ISO8601 with TZ offset.

devon.eng: If we accept minute pulses we need to ensure our ingestion partitioning can handle spikes — current shard key is customer_id + hour_bucket. minute pulses would require either finer keys or a short-term buffer.

aj.ops: hmm. can you paste an example payload so we can validate signature code?

devon.eng: sure — sample from partner (sanitized):
```json
{
  "partner_id": "cloudx-42",
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "usage": [
    {"timestamp": "2026-03-23T14:07:00-07:00", "units": 3},
    {"timestamp": "2026-03-23T14:08:00-07:00", "units": 2}
  ],
  "entitlements": [{"sku": "rwi-small-embed", "ent_id": "ENT-123"}],
  "signature": "sha256=abcd..."
}
```

lia.product: for entitlements mapping — CloudX uses their SKU string. We need a deterministic mapping table to our internal sku + plan id. Do we have migration for historical ent_id vs SKU?

maria.partners: They have a `ent_id` field sometimes missing on older devices. They want us to infer from SKU when ent_id missing. Should we accept that?

devon.eng: we can infer from SKU but must record a provenance flag (inferred_from_sku) and avoid auto-credit backfills without ops sign-off. Also need idempotency key: their example includes `tenant + timestamp + sku` but we should prefer a canonical event_id.

aj.ops: signature: they use HMAC-SHA256 over the body with a shared secret, header `X-CX-Sig: sha256=...`. Matches our webhook verifier template but watch canonicalization — they include spaces/newlines. Use raw body for HMAC.

sam-infra-bot: webhook-harness deployed to staging at https://staging-webhooks.internal.redwood /cloudx. Run `./tools/webhook-test --partner cloudx --payload sample.json` to push tests. :rocket:

lia.product: good. Can we run a 48h shadow run (ingest but not bill) and compare counts against partner hourly rollups? Action: maria to request rollup export from CloudX for the test window.

maria.partners: noted — requesting rollup export for 2026-03-20..2026-03-22.

devon.eng: ops plan:
- accept minute pulses into a transient minute_shard, rollup into hourly shards asynchronously
- dedupe using event_id if present, else `tenant+timestamp+sku` hash
- mark `provenance=inferred` when ent_id missing
- surface mismatches in a daily reconciliation job that compares our hourly rollups vs partner hourly rollups

aj.ops: any backfill strategy?

devon.eng: if partner provides historical hourly rollups, we'll run a backfill job that: ingest -> compute delta vs ledger -> create credit decisions flagged for manual review if delta > 0.1% or >500 units.

maria.partners: ask CloudX if their hourly rollups are computed from minute pulses server-side or sampled aggregates — matters for numeric reconciliation.

lia.product: also need to update integration docs: mapping table, signature header example, sample payload, test harness steps, and runbook for reconciliation alerts.

maria.partners: I'll draft the doc. action items: @devon.eng set staging webhook with minute_shard + dedupe logic; @aj.ops add verifier test + replay script; @lia.product prepare mapping doc and sample QA checklist; I'll coordinate export from CloudX.

sam-infra-bot: deploy job scheduled: webhook-worker:v2 -> staging, rolling over 2 nodes at 2026-03-23T15:10:00Z.

aj.ops: quick note — timezone handling: normalize all timestamps to UTC and store event_time_utc and original_timestamp_with_tz. Keep offset to help debug.

devon.eng: ACK. Also will add metric: percent of records with inferred ent_id and daily mismatch rate.

maria.partners: thx team. I'll follow up with CloudX and post their export when available. :thumbsup:

aj.ops: ping if you want an ops runbook snippet for emergency credits/rollback.

maria.partners: will do. Closing thread once export attached.
